key_insight: SCP-FTLE and SCP-FSLE accelerate three-dimensional material-stretching and transport-barrier analysis on CPUs and GPUs by reducing data movement and redundant computation.
engineering_relevance: The modules enable large-scale flow diagnostics for applications such as non-Newtonian cavity flows and urban tracer dispersion.
method: Support structured and native unstructured meshes with selectable integration and interpolation schemes.
Reuse rolling snapshots and batch FTLE computations within memory limits.
Keep trajectory state on-device and advance active FSLE trajectories.
evidence_signal: At one billion seeds, reported strong-scaling efficiencies on 32 GPUs are 86.3% for FTLE and 95.2% for FSLE; verification uses ABC, concentrated-vortex, linear-stretching and rotational-shear flows.
watch_item: Scaling efficiency does not establish absolute runtime; practical performance should be checked for the target mesh, hardware and integration settings.
paper_title: SCP-FTLE and SCP-FSLE: High-performance finite-time and finite-size Lyapunov-exponent computations for CPUs and GPUs
